name: Vahli Dikri Yojana
benefit: The following benefit will be provided to the beneficiary under Gujarat Vahli Dikri Yojana StagesAmountWhen a Girl enrolls in Class 1stRs. 4,000/-When a Girl enrolls in Class 9thRs. 6,000/-When Girl Pursue Higher Education or Getting MarriedRs. 1,00,000/-
eligibility_rules: This scheme is for the first two girl children of the family. Applicant must belong to Gujarat state. Applicant must have a bank account. The annual income of the applicant's family should not be more than Rs. 2 Lakh. Girls born after 02-08-2019 are eligible to get financial assistance under Gujarat Vahli Dikri Yojana.
documents_required: List of the required documentsDomicile of Gujarat. Aadhar Card. Passport Size Photo. Income
Certificate. Caste Certificate. Birth Certificate of Child. Bank Account Details.
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline Application ProcessApplicants can get the application form from the Anganwadi Centre/Gram Panchayat/ CDPO(ICDS) Office/District Women and child Officer office. Fill out the application form and attach all the required documents with it. Submit the Application Form along with the documents in the same office. Application Forms and Documents will be scrutinized by the concerned officials. The applicant will be informed through SMS about the eligibility or ineligibility. Eligible Beneficiaries will get financial assistance in their bank account once their application is finally approved by the department office.
